Alpha: paper. Beta: aluminium. Gamma: lead

walkthroughs.body_html:
Irradiation: radiation reaches you but you are not radioactive afterwards.

Contamination: radioactive material gets on or inside you - keeps emitting.

Medical tracer: short half-life and gamma (penetrates, leaves quickly).

Smoke alarm: long half-life alpha (stops in air, lasts years).

Sources: radon, food, cosmic rays, medical.

Subtract from measurements to find true source activity.
